element: Run route tube (3D, per-km pieces, lifted by heart rate)
screen: Run report hero (RunObject); same object as the Today moment
data_source: Shape: routePoints(w) = a closed radial loop from three seeded sine terms, rngFor("route"+w.id). No lat/lon anywhere in the model (workout keys: id,type,d,t,dur,secs,dist,avgHR,maxHR,kcal,elev,splits,rem,place,src). Height = smoothed synthetic HR (workoutSeries), not altitude; elevation exists only as one scalar w.elev. Per-km colour = real split pace.
native_route: HKWorkoutRouteQuery on the HKWorkout's HKWorkoutRoute -> [CLLocation] (coordinate, altitude, timestamp, horizontalAccuracy). Project to local metres (MKMapPoint or ENU around the start), simplify (Douglas-Peucker to ~200-400 pts), cut into km pieces by cumulative distance, height = altitude (or HR from HKQuantitySeriesSampleQuery on heartRate over the workout interval, matched by timestamp). Mesh: SceneKit custom SCNGeometry (tube sweep) or RealityKit MeshDescriptor (iOS 15+); RealityKit has no TubeGeometry/CatmullRom, you write the sweep yourself (~150 lines). Optional "on the map" view: SwiftUI Map (iOS 17) + MapPolyline per km with .mapStyle(.standard(elevation: .realistic)) and MapCamera pitch.
platform_limits: Real routes are not closed loops: out-and-back runs overlap themselves and collapse to one line from above; point-to-point runs are long and thin (aspect-fit breaks the 1.5:1 stage). Indoor/treadmill/pool workouts and runs without iPhone/Watch GPS have no route. GPS noise at start (first 100-300 m). Privacy: start/end usually at home. HR sampling during workouts is ~1/5 s, route ~1/s. watchOS has SceneKit (SwiftUI SceneView) but no RealityKit; keep meshes small, no transmission/clearcoat-heavy materials; battery: render once, no idle spin.
verdict: dynamic in principle but prototype fakes it
fix: Build from HKWorkoutRoute: x/z from projected lat/lon, y from altitude (honest "3D map") with HR shown as colour or as the lift only if labelled. Handle out-and-back by offsetting the return leg (time-ordered small lateral offset) or by lifting by time; fit the camera to the route's real aspect; trim the first/last 200 m (privacy zone) and drop low-accuracy points; when no route exists fall back to a split-pace ribbon (km pieces in a row, height = pace). Keep MapKit as a secondary "show on map" (not the hero) because Map is not stylable to the deep stage.
